subject: Operational acceptance: throughput & latency certification — run schedule and evidence bundle
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@lumencart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@lumencart.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding certification — initial kickoff and questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We want to move into formal performance certification for the LumenCart integration next week. Our security and SRE teams asked for a clear pass/fail matrix, a proposed run schedule, and the evidence bundle you’ll accept for signoff.

High level from our side: our production traffic pattern is a mix of short chat completions (avg 140 tokens) and catalog-search embedding calls. Peak concurrency is roughly 220 concurrent sessions during batch sales events — sustained spikes to 300 req/s are possible for ~5–10 minutes.

Can you propose:
- target latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) for the certified model variant,
- required throughput and duration for acceptance runs,
- warmup/priming guidance (KV cache, prefix caching), and
- where to upload our traffic sample and telemetry so you can reproduce our profile.

Also please list any artifacts you need from procurement for the Dedicated environment. We’d like this to be reproducible by our SREs and yours.

Thanks,
Sam

—
Sam Taylor
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenCart
sam.taylor@lumencart.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@lumencart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Aug 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding certification — initial kickoff and questions

Hi Sam — thanks, and great to see the traffic notes. Attaching a proposed benchmark runbook and a results template to guide evidence capture. [Attachment: lumencart_benchmark_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 140KB)] [Attachment: run_results_template.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

Summary of our suggested acceptance criteria for the initial certification run:
- Throughput target: sustain 300 req/s for a rolling 10-minute window (primary acceptance)
- Latency targets (for text generation requests): p50 < 120 ms, p95 < 400 ms, p99 < 800 ms
- Tail and timeout policy: fewer than 0.2% errors and fewer than 0.5% timeouts over the full run
- Resource stability: no OOMs or sustained GPU throttling; KV cache hit-rate & priming narrative included in evidence

Recommended run structure (details in the attached plan):
1) Pre-flight (30–45m): instance warmup, model-variant check, and KV cache priming using a 15-minute replay of a representative 1% sample
2) Baseline run (20m): low concurrency baseline to capture p50/p95 behavior
3) Stress window (2 x 10m windows with 5m ramp): bring to 300 req/s sustained, then step to 350 req/s spike test
4) Cooldown (10m): verify recovery and absence of error spikes

Evidence we will accept for signoff:
- Run logs and telemetry (token-level latency breakdown),
- JMeter/Gatling load script used,
- Model variant and quantization profile (model checksum),
- Run_results_template.csv filled out with aggregated metrics, and
- A short writeup describing cache priming steps and any deviations from the plan.

Upload instructions: we have a secure evidence folder for LumenCart — I’ll share a Drive link and a HubSpot deal record where you can attach artifacts.

Question for your SREs: do you have any hard constraints on allowed retry behavior or client-side timeouts during the acceptance runs? If so we’ll mirror them to make the test realistic.

We’ll coordinate a 2h window on Aug 14 for the end-to-end runs unless you prefer earlier. Ben and Karthik will be on the run and available for troubleshooting.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: lumencart_benchmark_plan_v1.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@lumencart.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Aug 2028 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding certification — initial kickoff and questions

Thanks Sam/Marissa — a few implementation notes from the SRE/SE side (see inline):

- Warmup/priming: plan to run a 15–20 minute prefix replay that contains the high-frequency prefixes we see in production (catalog queries). This materially improves KV cache hit-rate and stabilizes p95.
- Batching: for the throughput window, we’ll configure dynamic batching to favor latency SLOs until 200 req/s, then shift to throughput-priority batching for the 300 req/s sustained window. We’ll capture per-batch token counts in the evidence CSV.
- Model variants: recommend we start with open-model-3q-16g quantized as the baseline; if throughput falls short we can test open-model-3q-8g (smaller memory footprint) as a fallback. Please confirm which model checksums your team uses.
- Failure injection: we won’t proactively inject faults during certification but will run a quick tiered-degradation test if the baseline fails (to validate graceful fallback).

I’ve attached our loadscript template for your team to replay traffic locally and to produce the sample artifact that we’ll run in our Dedicated pool. [Attachment: loadscript-jmeter.jmx]

Action items for LumenCart:
1) Upload a traffic sample (1–5% prod slice) and a nominal replay script (we’ll adapt to our runner)
2) Confirm client timeout behavior — if you have a 1.5s client timeout we’ll match that to avoid false positives
3) Confirm preferred 2h window on Aug 14 or propose an alternate date

I’m adding a checklist to the Drive folder once you upload the traffic sample.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
[Attachment: loadscript-jmeter.jmx]
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@lumencart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@lumencart.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding certification — initial kickoff and questions

Marissa/Ben — thanks, that all looks good. We’ve scheduled the LumenCart SRE team for the Aug 14 window and uploaded a 3% production slice to the folder you shared. Files uploaded: prod_traffic_sample.json.gz (gzipped), client_timeout_policy.md, and a short readme with mapping for event types.

Notes/answers:
- Our client-side default timeout is 1.8s; we can reduce to 1.5s for the test window if you prefer.
- We prefer you run the baseline at 10:00am PT followed by the stress windows starting at ~10:30am PT.
- No objections to the model-variant plan — we will provide checksums for the production model and a small subset of golden prompts for quality checks.

Please confirm the Drive link and we’ll attach the evidence to the HubSpot deal after the run. If everything’s set we’ll be online at 09:45 to help with priming.

Best,
Sam

—
Sam Taylor
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenCart
sam.taylor@lumencart.com
[Attachment: prod_traffic_sample.json.gz]
